predecessor.information_change: Add a real camera-trajectory observation that projects the candidate axis into the current image frame; do not infer polarity from RGB appearance or a support-object boundary.

source.dataset: SceneFun3D train split plus ARKitScenes high-resolution camera trajectory

selection.ordering: ascending visit_id then video_id from the official one-video CSV
selection.stop_rule: Stop immediately after the first scene containing an admissible parent-level active-view opportunity.

frozen_algorithm.view_selection: Among real trajectory poses that contain every same-action candidate inside the frozen normalized frustum, maximize horizontal span, then minimize median depth, then choose earliest timestamp.
frozen_algorithm.left_right_authority: Camera-frame projected x coordinate from the selected real pose; smaller x is left.

forbidden_after_source_access: read description annot_id values or target membership
choose a camera pose using target identity, selector output, or evaluator score
change frustum, depth, span, dominance, lattice, or view-ranking thresholds
use RGB gradients, target appearance, sibling target order, or support-boundary polarity
reorder candidates or skip the first eligible scene
claim_boundary: Outcome-blind source admission for a real-pose active-view directional ordinal ceiling. Public task text, privileged functional labels, provider geometry, and camera trajectory are visible; target IDs and selector outcomes remain sealed. Passing does not establish RGB proposal quality, online view reachability, live tracking, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, or safety.
